description: Connects a domain to Anaverse Mail business email hosting: SPF authorization for the sending IP, the domain's DKIM signing key, a baseline DMARC policy (p=none, only applied when the domain has no DMARC record), and MX for incoming mail. The MX group is applied separately, after the customer moves existing mailboxes.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: base64 RSA public key generated by Anaverse Mail for this domain (the p= value of the DKIM record).
